title: MapleStory Classic F/P Wizard Build and Leveling Guide: Lv 30-70
intro: Fire/Poison Wizards' Fire Arrow burns down a target while poison spamming an entire map. They are the masters of damage over time effects.

blocks.p: This guide is based off of a realistic lv 70 F/P Wizard build by Grummash.
**Pros**

ul: #2 Physical EHP and tied #1 Magic EHP at level 70 in the current benchmark.
Fire Arrow deals 25% more damage to fire-weak mobs.
Poison Breath's contact explosion reaches up to four mobs.
Meditation gives nearby party members 25 Magic Attack.
Teleport and MP Eater improve movement and potion use.

blocks.p: **Cons**

ul: Fire-resistant mobs cut Fire Arrow's direct damage by 25%.
Max Poison Breath costs 40 MP per cast.
Low HP makes careless Magic Guard use expensive in MP.

blocks.p: This guide picks up from our Magician level 1 to 30 guide, which compares these first-job builds by meso cost. Any of them works for an F/P Wizard.
Safer moves 12 SP from Magic Armor to Magic Guard. Grummash's build needs an SP reset; its Cash Shop price is unconfirmed.
Stay with Kerning City from the Magician guide. Higher citizenship levels open Lesser Overall LUK and INT scrolls for mage robes, which fit the Angel Wings endpoint without giving up damage AP.
A training map only works when your attacks connect. Every miss spends MP, wastes the attack animation, and lowers EXP per minute.

blocks.h2: Levels 30-70: F/P Wizard skill build and leveling

blocks.p: Second-job SP cannot be spent on first-job skills, so finish the first-job plan by level 30. Character Builder flags any build that breaks it.

blocks.h3: Fire Arrow or Poison Breath first?

blocks.p: [[img:c5fb9f28d4a0c9.png]]Fire Arrow hits one mob hard. [[img:c2c06146bd2ee1.png]]Poison Breath's contact explosion hits up to four mobs, but deals far less damage to each one. Which to max first depends on how many mobs each Poison Breath actually hits.

EXP per minute at level 40 on the best launch map in Training Advisor. On one mob, [[img:24dcca787059a4.png]]Energy Bolt/[[img:5370722a856bb9.png]]Magic Claw 20 hits harder than Poison Breath 30, so the Poison Breath first column falls back to it.

The break-even is 2 mobs per cast. We max Fire Arrow first because most casts do not hit 2+ mobs when they are spread out, while Fire Arrow works on every map. Poison Breath pulls ahead of Fire Arrow if you can consistently hit 3 or more mobs every cast.

Against elemental-neutral mobs, keep using Energy Bolt or Magic Claw as your main attack until Fire Arrow reaches skill Lv21 at level 37. Against mobs weak to Fire, [[img:c5fb9f28d4a0c9.png]]Fire Arrow is the better skill from skill Lv15 at level 35. Fire-resistant mobs such as Fire Boar need Fire Arrow 30 before it beats Energy Bolt.

blocks.h3: Possible changes to the default order

blocks.p: If you consistently hit 3 or more mobs per cast, swap levels 31-40 and 41-50: max Poison Breath first, then Fire Arrow. At 3 mobs per cast it reaches about 6,222 EXP/min at level 40, against 4,243 for Fire Arrow.

Mostly fighting one mob at a time? After Fire Arrow 30, take MP Eater 3 at level 41 and max Meditation before Poison Breath. Poison Breath adds little on a single target, while Meditation raises every spell, for up to 12% more single-target damage between levels 42 and 55.
Raise Teleport after max Fire Arrow if platform movement matters more than early Poison Breath. Skill Lv10 costs 37 MP and moves 128 px.
The level-70 target is 299 base INT and 63 base LUK. Grummash reaches 65 Total LUK with equipment for Angel Wings. Check the equipped total before spending LUK; INT adds damage, MP, and Accuracy.

blocks.p: F/P Wizards can hold a shield with either a wand or a staff. Spell cast time does not change with weapon speed, so take the highest M.ATK you can equip. Pan Lid blocks more often than Esther Shield (8.09% against 5.30% Guard chance), while Esther Shield adds 55 MDEF against magic attacks. Every WDEF scroll on the shield raises Guard chance further.

blocks.h2: M.ATK or Critical Rate on gloves?

blocks.p: These numbers use Grummash's realistic level 70 F/P Wizard build and five successful Lesser glove scrolls. Both options use the same five slots.

**+10 M.ATK**
326 to 336 total M.ATK
About 3.07% more expected damage.

**+5% Critical Rate**
9% to 14% Critical Rate
About 1.27% more expected damage.

blocks.note: **Pick Magic Attack.** The five-scroll Magic Attack setup deals about 1.77% more expected damage than the Critical Rate setup on this build.

blocks.p: W.ATK does not increase spell damage. The matching Magic Attack scroll gives twice as much M.ATK as the Critical Rate scroll gives Critical Rate.

**The ratio is the same at every grade.** Lesser gives +1 W.ATK or +1% Critical Rate (+2 M.ATK), Intermediate +2/+2% (+4 M.ATK), Greater +3/+3% (+6 M.ATK), and Chaos +4/+4% (+8 M.ATK). Matching grades have the same success and destruction rates.

blocks.p: Max Fire Arrow has 180 Basic Attack and Mastery 10 for 28 MP. Fire-weak mobs take 25% more direct damage. Fire-resistant mobs take 25% less direct damage and can't be burned. Each hit also burns the target for 50 Basic Attack over 3 seconds, ticking once per second.
**The level 70 benchmark deals about 2,667 expected direct damage to a neutral target and 3,334 to a fire-weak target. The damage-over-time portion is excluded from those figures.**
The projectile hits one mob, then the contact explosion can damage up to four nearby mobs. Max Poison Breath has 80 Basic Attack, Mastery 10, a 75% poison chance, and costs 40 MP.
**One neutral poison tick on this build deals 512 damage, or 646 on a critical hit. The 9% critical rate puts the average at 524.06 per target. Against a poison-weak target, the average is 655.94.**

Poison ticks once per second for 5 seconds. It does not stack: casting again on a poisoned mob refreshes the 5 seconds instead of adding a second poison. Poison-resistant mobs can't be poisoned. The sustained benchmark below assumes you keep every target poisoned.
Max Meditation costs 25 MP and gives 25 Magic Attack to nearby party members for 300 seconds. It only boosts spell damage, and does not affect weapon damage.

blocks.h3: Fire and poison on Victoria Island

blocks.p: Fire Arrow has plenty of weak targets on Victoria Island. Poison Breath has three weak mobs and eight that resist it.
Weak mobs take 25% more damage. Resistant mobs take 25% less and can't be burned or poisoned by that element. The table covers regular spawns from level 20 up.

table: [[img:1d6ce5099450d1.png]]Curse Eye (Lv 33), [[img:110433cc83f147.png]]Jr. Boogie 2 (Lv 35), [[img:ab7412e282fc07.png]]Rafflesia (Lv 47), [[img:8d3453e377c2eb.png]]Duskmander (Lv 50), [[img:3e5429938ed2d5.png]]Stone Golem (Lv 56), [[img:d2be579f09f89b.png]]Rotten Mushroom (Lv 56), [[img:bf98edf794b720.png]]Dark Stone Golem (Lv 58), [[img:e5d5d56f40987e.png]]Sporewood (Lv 59)

blocks.p: Rafflesia and Sporewood are fire-weak but resist poison, so use Fire Arrow on them. Dark Stone Golem resists both. Green Mushrooms take no damage from poison at all. Fairy 2, 3, and 4 are the only poison-weak mobs, and their 500 MDEF is the highest in this table.

MP Eater drains at most once every 5 seconds, and it gets nothing from mobs with 0 MP. On Victoria Island that means Pig, Ribbon Pig, Wild Boar, Ligator, and Fire Boar. Bring extra MP potions when you farm fire-weak Ligators.

blocks.h2: Find Your Build's Best Training Map with Training Advisor

blocks.p: **Danger measures how hard a mob hits you for: under 10% of your HP is Safe, 10-24% is Caution, 25-49% is Danger, and 50%+ is Lethal.**
F/P has two different map lists: Fire Arrow wants a valuable fire weakness, while Poison Breath wants enough nearby mobs to use its four-target contact explosion.

ol: Load your F/P Wizard with the actual INT, LUK, Magic Attack, skills, shield, scrolls, and buffs.
Run Fire Arrow first, set reliability to 100%, and check whether each mob is fire-weak, neutral, or resistant.
Run Poison Breath again. Its Advisor damage covers the direct contact explosion. Poison ticks are outside this calculation.
Leave Factor Danger into recommendations enabled so Magic Guard, HP, MP, WDEF, and MDEF affect the ranking.
Compare the best direct one- or two-cast results, then check spawn density and Teleport access on the map page.
Check the nearest potion shop before committing to a map. A nearest-town scroll gets you back to town, but you still have to walk back to the map after every refill.

blocks.p: Fire Arrow is fairly cheap; Poison Breath and early Teleport are not. Full Magic Guard adds another large MP expense when mobs hit you: at the basic shop rates, every 100 incoming damage costs about 90 mesos to refill through MG 15, compared with 50 mesos when MG stays off. Use MG only if you're at risk of dying.

ol: **Ignoring elemental resistance.** Fire Arrow loses damage against fire-resistant mobs. Check the mob page before committing to a map.
**Spamming Teleport 1.** It costs 55 MP. Early Teleport is for useful gaps and emergencies.
**Casting Meditation for physical attackers.** It adds Magic Attack, so it helps magical damage.
**Adding LUK after the weapon requirement is met.** Check Total LUK from gear before spending more base AP.
